section_summary.extract_value: This section details a single path analysis model that investigated whether social safeness and body appreciation (BAS-2) mediate the impact of early memories of warmth and safeness on disordered eating attitudes (EDE-Q), while controlling for BMI. The final model demonstrated an excellent fit to the empirical data, with all path coefficients being statistically significant, and explained 51% of the variance in EDE-Q.
